sourceChecks.text: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBはJeushをエサウの子らの一人として列挙する。

sourceChecks.text: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はビルハンの子Jeushを記し、1:35のエサウ系譜とは別の系譜位置。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はエシェクの子Jeushを記し、1:35のエサウ系譜とは別の系譜位置。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はシメイの子Jeushを記す。1:35のエサウ系譜とは別人として扱う。

sourceChecks.text: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 代名詞的な後続記述は23:10のレビ人Jeushを指す。
